first.rationale: Prioritize reversing the concurrent onboarding-completion and activation declines with the direction that previously improved completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. Verify the onboarding evidence and the pricing retention trade-off before committing, since competitor pricing creates pressure to discount but durable memory indicates promotional pricing harmed 30-day retention and is not a sustainable general strategy.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified prior result directly addresses both current declines: onboarding completion increased 13%, time-to-value fell 2.1 days, and 30-day retention increased 3%. This is aligned with sustainable qualified revenue, unlike promotional pricing, whose verified acquisition lift was accompanied by a 12% retention decline. Evaluate completion, first meaningful action, qualified conversion, and 30-day retention by segment before any rollout.
